timeline_node.required_operands: ALL dates from >=2 distinct source docs, carried in the FactLedger with fid+doc+span
timeline_node.computation_rule: for each cross-doc date pair (a,b): interval_days=|b-a|; emit one derived fact per pair citing operand fids
timeline_node.unknown_boundary: either doc contributes ZERO dates -> emit {status:'insufficient_evidence', note:'缺少<doc>侧日期操作数'}; asserting an interval without both operands is a CONTRACT VIOLATION

verification_node.required_operands: the cross-doc comparable value pair (both sides) present in the ledger with fids+spans
verification_node.computation_rule: compare the two values; emit conclusion citing BOTH values and spans
verification_node.output_schema: new_facts += {content:'<项>不一致（方案1:0.1335 vs 公告1:0.1339）', operand_fids:[fa,fb], status:'confirmed'}
verification_node.unknown_boundary: one side missing -> {status:'insufficient_evidence', note:'无法比较：缺<doc>侧操作数'}; asserting 一致/不一致 with a single operand is a CONTRACT VIOLATION (the E3 fabrication class, scorer-refused)
verification_node.scorer_hook: operand-aware crediting requires both canonical operands AND the conclusion; violations remain detectable
